problem: Offline actor-critic methods can overestimate unsupported actions and choose policies that exploit function-approximation errors.
contribution: ConservativeQ-Learning adds a criticregularizer to learn pessimistic value estimates and improve offline policies without explicitly fitting a behavior-policy constraint.
algorithm: PenalizeQunder a selected actiondistribution and offset with dataset-actionQalongsideBellman error. Practical entropy/log-sum-exp and alternative variants modifySACorQ-learning critic updates; the penalty can be dual-tuned.
observations: Offline benchmark states orAtari pixels; observations are dataset- and implementation-specific.
actions: Continuous actions for actor-critic and discrete actions forQR-DQN-style variants; these are separate implementations.
embodiment_and_data: D4RL gym,AntMaze,Adroit andKitchen plus restrictedAtari replay subsets; noROSMASTER/SO101physical validation is provided.
experiments: Measure normalized returns over4seeds, test complex offline data distributions, sparse manipulation/maze tasks and low-dataAtari; examine predicted conservative values against actualreturns.
baselines: SAC,BC,BEAR,BRACvariants andQR-DQN/REM for discrete tasks;CQLvariants differ in importance-weighting stability.
limitations: The tighter theorem bounds expectedpolicyvalue, not every state-actionQpointwise, and relies on sampling/approximation assumptions. Conservative estimates are not a collisionavoidance or gripforce guarantee. Penalty and importance-sampling variance affect high-dimensionalactions.
hardware_adaptation: Use as an offlinebaseline only after reward labels and actioncontracts are defensible; avoid adding a heavysecondlearner before theworkingACTpath. Treat measuredphysical outcomes separately from learnedvalue bounds.
algorithm_detail: Equation1 gives a looser pointwise pessimistic form;Equation2 adds a datasetQmaximization term that tightens expectedpolicyvalue but neednot preserve pointwisebounds. Actor-critic and discreteQvariants share regularizationprinciples, not identical actioninterfaces.
integration_contract: Bind CQLvariant, penalty/dualupdate settings, sampled-action proposal, rewardscaling and terminationsemantics to eachcheckpoint. Preserve source-domain provenance when mixing simulation andphysicaltransitions.
license_evidence: PrimaryNeurIPS/arXivfulltext read; no officialcode or code/model/data license audit completed for thisreview. A mathematicalbaseline may be compared only through an attributed, licensedimplementation.
required_experiments: OfflineBC/IQL/CQL comparison on the same valid split andcompute; predictedvalue-versus-independentreturn calibration; penaltyablation; dataset-support andcross-embodiment actioncompatibility checks.
difference_from_explorer: Pessimistic offlineRL is published priorwork, not a new evidencegroundedmemory or diagnosticmethod. Explorer must isolate its additional sourcecompatibility/adaptation claims.
